entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Update async `Main` code generation #80873
    .NET 11
  • SyntaxTrivia.RequiredUnderlyingNode fails assertion when building SDK repo #80869
  • `csc` misinterprets a source file in root directory on Unix as a command-line option switch #80865
    18.3
  • VS2026 not respecting UseSolutionNavigatorGraphProvider = 0 #80860
  • AD0001 - System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException #80858

Closed

  • Scoped constructor parameters should be able to reference top-level locals #80745
    18.3
  • Fix LSP RequestMetrics based telemetry reporting #68790
    Backlog
  • CS8603 False positive when using yield return with netstandard2.0 #80867
  • InvalidCastException in VB SymbolDisplay when using UseArityForGenericTypes option #80165
    18.2
  • IDE0028 suggests an unsafe collection initializer when the type is `IDisposable` and initialized in a using statement #80862
  • Unsafe not required for pointer type in type parameter #44088
  • Interlocked.Exchange: compiler choses wrong Exchange with nullable types #49525
    Backlog
  • c# SyntaxFactory.ParseAttributeArgumentList throws NullReferenceException with invalid string #23877
    Backlog
  • Compiler crash with syntax error in indexer declaration #43145
  • Consider tests demonstrating a runtime null reference exception when iterating over null. #80838
    18.3
  • "Entry point cannot be marked async" error not showing in Build + IntelliSense Error List #17259
    Backlog
  • Source Generators: show generated files in solution explorer without loosing intallisense #80849
  • Change signature refactoring doesn't update argument list in `class_base` #67016
    Backlog
  • Implicit conversion method prioritized over type declaration when using "Go to definition" on invalid constructor #73498
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-11122.196 #80856
  • IDE0036 not raised for `protected private` and `internal protected` members #73768
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Add note on traversal order for bound nodes #80872
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Extract raw string literal auto-insert logic into reusable service #80871
    VSCode
  • Add information for NuGet package version 4.14 #80870
  • Fix csc/vbc misinterpretation of source files in root directory on Unix #80866
  • Add Solution Explorer option to control symbol display #80861
    Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #80859
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Ensure that locals at the top level of a constructor have the same safe-context as parameters #80807
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Merge main into features/collection-expression-arguments. (#80510) #80868
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • Fix IDE0028 to not suggest collection initializers for IDisposable types in using declarations #80863
    VSCode, Next
  • Fix handling of SymbolDisplayCompilerInternalOptions.UseArityForGenericTypes option for non-native symbol implementations #80826
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add back old DocumentSpan constructor #80864
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add regression test for Interlocked.Exchange with nullable types #80796
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add tests verifying pointer types in type parameters require unsafe context #80776
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add runtime NullReferenceException validation to foreach null iteration tests #80839
    Area-Compilers, Test, Next
  • Add regression test for compiler crash with syntax error in indexer declaration #80772
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add regression test for ParseAttributeArgumentList with invalid input (fixes #8699) #80705
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Update MicrosoftBuildTasksCoreVersionForMetrics to 17.11.48 #80812
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Mark CS4009 error as a "build only" error. #80698
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • Remove RestoreUseStaticGraphEvaluation workaround #80852
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix go to definition for conversions on invalid constructor overloads #78514
    Area-Compilers, Need More Info, Community, untriaged, Next

Updated

  • Make string concat assert more precise #80619
    Area-Compilers
  • Get solution explorer symbol view working on .Net Fx projects #80837
    Area-IDE
  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Fbp live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Mention conditionals in CFG section in Compiler Test Plan #80855
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • More tests for 'with(...)' element scenarios. #80831
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Extensions: address some diagnostic quality issues #80827
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Don't add parenthesis when committing type with accessible nested type using dot #80846
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove warning from 'in enum' extension methods #80708
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Unify raw string lexing and parsing #80817
    Area-Compilers
  • Add localized MSBuild warning when DOTNET_HOST_PATH is not found #80739
  • Use standard lookup and overload resolution for `true`/`false` operators while binding applications of user-defined `&&`/`||` operators #80836
    Area-Compilers
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ref safe context of assignments to be their RHS #80633
    Area-Compilers
  • Use core compiler on netfx hosts with toolset package #80631
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix IsSymbolAccessibleWithin to respect EmbeddedAttribute #80681
  • Try to reuse initialized generator drivers when we can #80845
    Area-IDE, VSCode
